    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
      ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier

    SELECT
        c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        COALESCE(SUM(lc.Claim_Amount), 0) AS incurred_loss
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
    LEFT JOIN loss_components AS lc
      ON lc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_charged
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" AS p
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS pa
      ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
      ON pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date

)
